name: Cummins India Limited
summary: Cummins India Limited engages in the design, manufacture, distribution, and service of engines, generator sets, and related technologies in India, Nepal, and Bhutan. The company operates through two segments, Engines and Lubes. It provides accelera, G-drive, fire pump drive, hydrogen, and natural gas and browse engines; and generators and power systems, including integrated power systems, alternators, transfer switches, generator set controls, system level controls and switchgears, remote monitoring, and browse generators.
